description: Monitor a specific URL on one of your verified sites (for example an API health route, login or checkout page) with a GET or HEAD request on a schedule. The domain must be verified first, and the URL must not include a query string. Optionally require an exact HTTP status, a text snippet in the response, and a maximum response time. You get an email alert when it fails twice in a row and when it recovers. Wardzo never submits forms or sends request bodies.

expect_keyword.description: Text that must appear in the response body (GET only)

expect_status.description: Exact expected HTTP status (default: any 2xx or 3xx)

max_ms.description: Fail if the response takes longer than this many milliseconds

site.description: Site id, domain or URL of one of your monitored sites

url.description: Full URL on that site, or a path like "/api/health"

name: add_endpoint
title: Add an endpoint check
